name: deskutils
description: Stateless utility commands for timezone-aware current time, character and word counts, and safe quotes of accessible Discord messages.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store any data or metadata about users. When an LLM agent calls its tools (for example quote, which returns a message's content and author), the result goes back to that agent and so to corridor's LLM endpoint.
install_msg: Install corridor too ([p]cog install pixel-agents-cogs corridor); it loads automatically. No outside services, no stored data and no extra setup: [p]deskutils time, count and quote work right away and also become pico LLM tools when pico is loaded.
author: nntin-bot
